misconfig_patterns: v1.x: NO authentication whatsoever — full Redis management interface exposed
v2.x < 2.50: no auth by default; optional password added later, not enforced
GET /api/databases returns connected Redis instances with plaintext AUTH passwords (Insight #61)
POST /api/databases/{id}/cli/send-command = arbitrary Redis command execution (CONFIG GET/SET, KEYS *, DUMP)
Pivots to connected Redis even when Redis :6379 itself is firewalled

active_probe.false_positive_check: title-substring 'Redis Insight' (space) is tokenized by Shodan and over-matches; require 200-with-data on /api/instance or /api/databases before labeling. Port alone is never sufficient (population spans 40+ ports).

deployment_tells: Title bucket split: 'RedisInsight' (no space, v1.x/v2.x) vs 'Redis Insight' (space, v3.x rebrand) — two distinct Shodan populations
v3.x builds serve title 'Redis Insight' (space); v2 Electron 'dark' population catchable via 'X-Powered-By: Express' + 'Content-Length: 761'
pivot_paths: GET /api/databases/{id}/info → Redis INFO (version, config, connected clients)
GET /api/settings → application settings incl. stored credentials
vulnerabilities: Unauth data access — design decision, not a CVE; widely observed at population scale
harvest_notes: Flat title dork caps at ~200 paginated results (total-results claims 842 for 'Redis Insight'); country-split (country:US, country:DE, ...) breaks the cap and paginates each sub-bucket fully.
facet=port and facet=country are credit-free and drive both the cap-break split and the scan-phase --ports.
sources: [CONFIRMED —  RedisInsight survey; 953-host live corpus observed 2026-07-20; 824 net-new via facet-split cap-break]
